title: Pin the documented error codes of the LLM provider directory and model discovery
task:
Problem: the configurable-provider directory and model discovery document stable error codes in packages/llm/llm/README.md:15-17 (`INVALID_DIRECTORY`/`DUPLICATE_DIRECTORY` for `registerConfigurableProviders`, `INVALID_DISCOVERY`/`DUPLICATE_DISCOVERY` for `registerModelDiscovery`) and the source documents `REGISTRATION_DISPOSED` for a disposed handle (packages/llm/llm/src/index.ts:266 and :289). The throws live at packages/llm/llm/src/index.ts:377, :461, :464, :468, :480, :494, :525, :528 and :558, but every test reaching them matches message text only (packages/llm/llm/tests/topology.spec.ts:159-232), and no file under any tests directory in the repository contains `INVALID_DIRECTORY`, `DUPLICATE_DIRECTORY`, `DUPLICATE_DISCOVERY` or `REGISTRATION_DISPOSED`. A code rename would pass every gate while breaking configuration surfaces that branch on the code.

Required: add packages/llm/llm/tests/directory-error-codes.spec.ts that drives each path through the public `ctx.llm` service (build the context the way topology.spec.ts does) and asserts an `LlmError` with the exact `code`: an empty entry list and an entry with an empty `settingsPath` segment give `INVALID_DIRECTORY`; a provider declared twice in one call, a provider another registration already declares, and `handle.replace()` naming a provider another registration owns give `DUPLICATE_DIRECTORY`; `replace()` on a disposed directory handle and on a disposed adapter registration give `REGISTRATION_DISPOSED`; an empty namespace and a discovery without a provider give `INVALID_DISCOVERY`; a second discovery offer for one namespace gives `DUPLICATE_DISCOVERY`. Assert codes, not messages, and assert that the rejected call left the previous state intact where the README promises all-or-nothing.

Constraints: no source change; the service and its messages stay as they are.
